evaluator.name: Codex plus deterministic validators and in-app browser proof

contractChecks.evidence: Approved Deep Mineral sphere shading is the only identity variable added; external glow, CSS shadow and new renderer work are forbidden.
Perfect circle, hard edge, white Wings at 39% and MZ-G13 colour remain unchanged from canonical disc 1.0.0.
One live sphere is allowed only for an earned focal product; repeated and compact contexts resolve to the disc.
Seven viewport checks, forced static and disabled WebGL preserve 1:1 geometry, fixed Wings, exact colour and zero overflow.
Candidate source, review, package and manifest all keep productionAuthority false.
Olli approved sphere-contract-01 and DEC-SPHERE-EXPRESSION-001 records canonical 1.0.0.

qualityDimensions.evidence: The first screen says exactly what is being approved and explicitly excludes typography, copy, colour, disc and homepage composition.
Depth is isolated as the only new variable over the same core and fixed mark.
One-live maximum, 360px floor and compact disc substitution keep the sphere rare.
The proof distinguishes exact source colour from parametric depth instead of claiming an exact static sphere.
Immutable dependencies are hash-protected and promotion is blocked by the named human gate.

notes: Machine, visual and human review are complete. Sphere expression 1.0.0 is canonical for its declared scope and EXP-03 is active.
